reviews.text:
My sweet adorable RESCUE hava-poo has certainly come along way!! I reached out to Jay one afternoon in a haste since RIkki got off leash and was running like crazy down the street. I thought it was time for a bit more training and I found Jay and was pleased with his reviews.  He was responsive and we set up a meeting  immediately and what I can say is that my little RIkki was initially very comfortable and was very in tune with Jay. That in itself was a big plus and  the response from Rikki was terrific.
Jay certainly has a way with digs and I highly suggest you engage  him.
Jay was an amazing trainer! My Zarita (toy poodle) is doing so great with her commands. Jay was patient and very informative at all times. Would so recommend!!

We had a great experience! Our trainer Jay was knowledgeable, patient and truly cared about helping Zoey succeed. We immediately saw a huge improvement and felt confident handling different situations.  Highly recommend Top Dog Training to anyone looking for an effective and caring trainer!

From the first session to the last Jay was wonderful with our Golden Doodle and totally non-judgmental about my husband and I as trainers!  He was effective in helping us find ways to train our dog to have better people greeting behaviors, reduce his barking, and help us gain more control when walking with him on a leash. Our 2 1/2 year old puppy loved him and was very attentive when being taught by Jay. He uses edible treats, petting and obvious love for reinforcing behaviors. I do wish he could move in with us for a couple of weeks to work with our dog with the consistency needed for better success!!  But, alas, that is not possible. We, as owners, could have done a better job with applying techniques we were taught.  Many thanks Jay. You are a very talented trainer.

Working with Jay has been really helpful! He is efficient, patient, and knowledgeable.
In a short amount of time, my dog, an 8 month bernedoodle, learned several new commands, and his walking skills have improved drastically. On top of the structured training, he provided a lot of tips and tricks that made continuing the practice at home smooth and effective.
If you're looking for a top-tier trainer who delivers results, I highly recommend.

Jay was great with our 15 month old female mix breed (American Pit, Australian cattle, Labrador) Nelly. He taught the kids and I how to be consistent with commands and made some great recommendations for harnesses and training treats. I am so much more comfortable walking Nelly. I’m not worried she’s going to launch at a person or dog walking past us! She responds to multiple commands and I really feel like she’s better communicating to us what she wants/ needs. Thanks Jay!!!

Jay has been an amazing trainer for our Otto and taught him and us so much during our lessons. In less than 2 months we already see so much positive change. He came to our house and tailored the training to exactly what we asked for. It was also clear that he was adapting his advice to our specific dog and not just working off of a pre-determined curriculum. We definitely recommend Top Dog Training to anyone looking for an in-home trainer!

We recently used Top Dog to train our 3 month old Cavapoo.  They were absolutely great!  Not only did they get my bdog to obey but theybtaught us methods that we can use to continue her training.  They were ver accessible and told us to feel free to contact them at any time if we have any questions at all.  My recommendation, if you are considering hiring a trainer, is to use them Both you and your dog will be happy!
Jay was amazing training my 2 dogs .

Jay is incredible. I adopted Theo in November, and to say he has a lot of energy… understatement. Jay helped me build an amazing foundation with his training. He’s amazing while walking on a leash, never pulls. Within a few weeks we were able to be off leash at the beach. So happy with what we’ve learned. Thank you, Jay!!

Jay was the BEST dog trainer I have ever been to. I went to 3 others and no results . I even left my dog with 1 trainer for 3 weeks, and my Morkie came back the same way. I was so disappointed. Working with Jay for 1 hour - my dog could sit, stay, come to me. I ONLY wish I found him first. Bravo 👏

Highly recommend Top Dog Training. Jay was an excellent teacher to both our family and our French bulldog. We all learned many good tips and commands. We enjoyed working with him and will miss our sessions.

We had such a great experience with Jay! He was so professional, kind, and caring, and Toni absolutely loved him. He made the whole training process feel easy and comfortable, and we could tell he really cared about helping her. Toni is already doing so much better, and we’re so grateful for all of his help. Highly recommend him!

I loved having Jay work with me and my new puppy, Penny! I’m amazed at how many cute little tricks she was able to learn. I highly recommend his service. It made me love my little girl so much more. It’s a fun way to bond with your dog and really see how much they’re capable of.

I’d highly recommend Jay to anyone looking for a dog trainer. He is very helpful, knowledgeable, professional, and kind. My dog LOVED working with him. Jay makes the sessions educational and fun for the dogs. I’m really impressed with the improvements my puppy has made in a short period of time.

We had a great experience working with Jay! He was patient, knowledgeable, and made every session enjoyable and easy to follow. His positive training methods really worked for our dog and we saw a big improvement in her behavior and confidence in just a short time. We highly recommend Jay to anyone looking for a caring and effective trainer!

Jay was wonderful to work with in training my Westie, Lily to become a Good Canine Citizen and psychiatric service dog. I feel confident bringing her just about anywhere because she has the ability to control herself and I have the skills to manage her, all thanks to Jay’s patient, positive techniques. This was no small task, as terriers and Westies in particular are stubborn and highly prey driven. I feel more bonded with Lily after going through this process. Jay is very professional and responsive and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him to any dog parent.
Jay was very helpful with my 8 year old rescue dog Vivi…. He’s gentle and patient ….and Vivi responded  very well to his training.  Thank you, Jay!

We had a great experience working with Jay for Peaches dog training. Jay helped her tremendously with sitting, laying down, and overall listening skills. Peaches genuinely looked forward to every session, and his training approach was always positive and encouraging. Jay is very professional, easy to work with, and we look forward to continuing training with him in the future. Highly recommend!!
Jay was great with our pup. Even with setbacks he gives great feedback and tons of info supported by links and teaching materials.
My husband & I and our pup, juno have learned so much together. Thanks to Jay :)

First time doing any type of private training and will never have a puppy Jay is not there to help train moving forward!
Jay was absolutely outstanding and so knowledgeable, his ability to guide us through the process and make it feel easy was 10/10.
Our Teacup Yorkie Maurice and I (not sure who learned more!) gained so much trust and confidence in our routine and process it has helped us bond and enjoy our space and time together more.
Jay was very patient, professional and knowledgeable. Highly recommend him

Great experience!  He really took the time to teach us the fundamentals on getting our large chocolate lab puppy used to commands & listening.  Great tips and tricks that will last a lifetime with our fur baby!! 🐶 ❣️ …

Jay is amazing! My 3-month-old puppy, Lola, loved her training sessions and was always excited to see him.

I was honestly expecting puppy training to be stressful, but Jay made it feel easy. I was surprised by how quickly she picked things up. Most importantly, he taught us how to keep the progress going at home, which made all the difference.

If you’re thinking about training, I 100% recommend his services. Thank you, Jay!

Our golden retriever puppy "Archie" got the best start under Jay's tutelage! Not only was Jay's positive reinforcement technique for training Archie highly effective, he also taught us how to achieve the same results. It was an incredible learning experience for both our puppy and us in only 5 sessions! I would highly recommend Jay to anyone looking for a dog trainer.

We cannot say enough amazing things about our experience training with Jay!! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ From the very first session, it was clear just how incredibly knowledgeable and passionate he is about what he does. He took the time to really understand our needs and gave us the tools and confidence to succeed.
Our boxer puppy, Charlie, has transformed so quickly—it’s honestly unbelievable! He’s now obedient, well-behaved, and such a joy to be around. The progress we’ve seen in such a short time has truly been life-changing for our entire family (and for Charlie too!).
Jay’s training methods are effective, clear, and easy to follow, and he made the whole process enjoyable and rewarding. We feel so much more connected with our pup and equipped as dog owners.
If you’re even thinking about dog training—do it, and book with Jay immediately. We would recommend him to ANY dog owner, without hesitation. Absolute game changer!! 🐾✨
Jay was very easy to work with and shared great tips to set our new puppy up for success.

Jay is an exceptional trainer. He was patient not only with our puppy but also with us, showing us how to keep the training going after each session. Since we started, we’ve seen a huge improvement, and on walks people always compliment how well-behaved our puppy is.

He made everything easy to understand and gave us confidence to stay consistent. We’re really grateful for his help and highly recommend him.

We would highly recommend Jay at Top Dog Training South Florida! He helped us immensely with our Staffie, Winnie, who needed basic functional obedience. The difference we see is amazing. He also taught us how to stop her barking too much, and jumping on people. Winnie loved her sessions with Jay, and it's been good for her to learn new things! The whole family enjoyed the sessions with Jay. Definitely recommend you call Jay to help you train your dog! We hope to work with him again someday to add more skills to Winnie's repertoire.

Leave it to Top Dog. Jay is a true dog whisperer.  Had a large breed puppy that needed to learn some obedience. Jay worked with him and the psychology of the breed and we have a well behaved puppy. Will continue using Top Dog through my dogs life
Training our dog with Jay from Top Dog has been a great experience. Jay has a way with animals that is very impressive.  We learned so much from him.  Highly recommend!!

My 10 month old Australian labradoodle and I learned a lot and enjoyed our sessions with Jay.  We have done dog training with others but Jay was definitely next level far and above.  He was calm and professional plus so good with us.  I would highly recommend Jay absolutely as a “Top Dog” trainer.  Very appropriate name!!

We had a fantastic experience with Jay and his 5-session puppy package. We started when our golden retriever, Barkley, was just 8 weeks old.

Jay was patient, knowledgeable, and gave us clear, practical tools to use at home. By the end of the program, Barkley was confidently sitting, laying down, and doing “paw” on command.

Highly recommend Jay to anyone looking to build a strong foundation with their puppy!

Jay has done wonders for my two 4 year old miniature dachshunds! After 5 sessions their aggressive behavior is almost nonexistent, and they are almost completely house trained. My friends and family and I are amazed at their transformation. I highly recommend Jay and his highest rated Top Dog Training without reservation.
Jay is the best! Very knowledgeable, patient, and caring with our Bernedoodle puppy.

Jay was so helpful in getting Greg up to speed on important puppy training milestones. Greg has become so confident in his tricks, walks well on a leash, knows how to come, lay down, drop it, etc. all thanks to Jay. It was so convenient being able to train at our house, and we are better dog parents knowing how to be able to motivate Greg to follow important commands. 10/10 recommend.

If you’re looking for a dog trainer, stop right here!😏 I’m gonna tell you why! Jay is a great trainer, he’s very professional, knows a lot about dogs ans LOVES dogs and what he does, which is really important for this type of profession🐾 he reaches me a lot about communication with my dog, I had an 11 weeks old toy poodle with a train of energy, separation anxiety (he would literally scream like a siren when I was leaving😃), he was not doing so good with potty training, chewing on everything including my face and hands. I didn’t know what to do🥲 and I found Jay.
5 weeks later I have a calm, brave, confident puppy who listens to me and knows what he’s supposed and not supposed to do, potty and crate trained and also we bonded very strongly and nicely☺️
He still is a puppy and it’s a way to go but the base he has and the knowledge I got from Jay is gonna lead us to a happy and stress free life for both of us.
Thank you, Jay! God bless
Jay has been amazing working with my new puppy and me. I would highly recommend him to anyone looking for some behavioral and basic training for your dog.
